explanation: Calligraphers grind a solid ink stick with a little water on the inkstone. Inkstones from Duanxi in Guangdong have been prized since the Tang dynasty.

claims.text: The Four Treasures of the Study in Chinese calligraphy are the brush, the ink, the paper and the inkstone.
The seal, the brush rest and the silk scroll are not among the Four Treasures of the Study.
Chinese ink is traditionally a solid stick ground with water on an inkstone.
Inkstones from Duanxi in Guangdong have been prized since the Tang dynasty.
